trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and it's healthy again. But opening the incident created a duplicate: there are now two identical open SEV2 incidents.

**Rollback**
- v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0, so I rolled back to that. No approval was needed because it had been healthy in production before.
- After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%.

**Incident**
- My first request to open the SEV2 incident timed out. The incident list was still empty when I checked, so I sent the request again. That returned INC-0002 and paged on-call.
- When I checked the list again, the request that timed out had also gone through as INC-0001. Both have the same title and summary: what failed, the rollback, the recovery, and follow-ups on the root cause and why a build that failed in staging was promoted.
- On-call may have been paged twice. I can't close or merge incidents with the tools I have, so someone needs to close INC-0002 as a duplicate of INC-0001.
